title: 第11章 再悟《天河剑诀》
slug: 修罗武帝全本免费-修罗武帝最新章节列表
content_zh:
深渊之中，到处是黑色的巨大锁链。
黑色的巨大锁链上，焚烧着熊熊的火焰，火焰呈现出刺眼的紫色。
紫色的火焰深处，彷佛封锁着一只双眼血红的凶物。
那只双眼血红的凶物身材很长，两片玉色的羽翼交叉着包裹着躯体。它两条腿只有双膝下面露了出来，但露出来的部分，上面伤痕累累，似乎又有着许许多多密密麻麻的符文。
这，也仅仅是一刹那的结果。
这一刹那，姜辰浑身都僵了，同时浑身凉透，甚至，如有一股极为刺的寒意直接冲进体内，让他不由打了个寒颤。
仅仅是刹那的感应，姜辰的魂力便中断消失了。
但是这个刹那，却给姜辰留下了深不可测的印象。
姜辰觉得，这一辈子，他都无法忘记这无比深刻的一幕。
“呜呜——”
“呦呦——”
姜辰清醒了过来，但耳边恍若时时刻刻有着惨厉的嘶嚎声。
姜辰的手，陡然一松，那玉质古剑，立刻坠落在地上。
一切异常，立刻消失了。
姜辰沉默不语。
之前，他还有些怀疑，怀疑姜峰是进入了一个禁忌之地，取得了这柄古剑。
如今，他几乎完全可以肯定是这样了。
不仅是这古剑，便是那三套‘风灵避尘甲’，也同样如此。
“却不知，是什么地方弄到的，那里，必定有着天大的秘密！”
姜辰思虑着，却暂时没有再去感应那玉色古剑，反而再次将古剑捡起，并将其收入了乾坤戒指之中。

随后，姜辰从乾坤戒指之中拿出自己湛蓝色的古卷《天河剑诀》来。
如今，他主要的心思，是真正的参悟《天河剑诀》。
《天河剑诀》，表面上有六重，可是剑诀的卷中还额外有信息，这种信息，不呈现于湛蓝色古卷上，而是需要以修炼灵魂的方式读取。那额外信息，其中就包含了《天河剑诀》额外的修炼之法。
在三年前，姜辰也并没有参悟出《天河剑诀》的额外修炼之法，而他交给林雪瑶的临摹的那份，因而也就只有基本的六重。
这，倒是万幸。
不过，这也是因为当初姜辰灵魂魂力修炼并没有大成的原因。
如今，姜辰拿出《天河剑诀》，便是想真正的了解《天河剑诀》的整体。
姜辰深深的明白，任何修炼，大局观是非常重要的，有了对于大局观的把握，整体上的修炼才可以更加的沉稳。
再一个，姜辰有着特别的自信，如今他的领悟力，非常的出色，若是结合眉心的血色魂海空间的话，只怕是领悟任何功法，都不会有什么难度。
姜辰仔细的观看《天河剑诀》，虽然他已经文字本身，也是携带着气势的，当初的姜辰根本不可能懂得这些。
可是如今的姜辰，却深深的明白这一点。
因而，这一次，他将《天河剑诀》完整的看了一次，将那些文字的轨迹，全部深深的镌刻到了脑海之中。
随后，姜辰又运转灵魂修炼之法，汇聚魂力，感应向那《天河剑诀》。
“嗡——”
灵魂力量刚刚涌动，感应了过去，《天河剑诀》立刻一震，竟是化作一道流光，忽然射入姜辰的眉心。
“咦？”
姜辰略微诧异，他没有想过，竟是这样的情况。
不过姜辰也不觉得奇怪，本身，灵魂感应力这种事情，一般的修士也是没有的，即便有，运用能力也很粗浅。
他拥有，很多的原因就是因为《天河剑诀》之中的灵魂修炼之法。
《天河剑诀》既然和灵魂相关，想来进入灵魂之中，也就不奇怪了。

姜辰凝神屏息，以冥想之法，立刻进入灵魂空间之中。
刚刚进入那片血色灵魂海洋空间，姜辰就发现，空间的血色，已经全部消失了。
这是一片非常清秀的虚空，虚空上方，很多七彩神光，如彩虹一样的悬挂着。
彩虹之中，隐约有着无尽沉寂的七彩神雷。
而虚空下方，是一片静寂的海洋。
海洋无比清澈。
眼下，这片虚空，没有陆地，只有碧海和彩色虚空，像是天清气朗的世界一样。
姜辰颇为惊讶，他没有想到，不觉之间，灵魂空间竟是有这样的变化。
不过，这样的诧异感生出之后，姜辰又立刻明白，原来，这是因为他的灵魂如今真正的一片清澈的原因。

content_en:
In the abyss, there are huge black chains everywhere.
The huge black chain was burning with blazing flames, and the flames showed a dazzling purple color.
In the depths of the purple flame, a vicious creature with blood-red eyes seemed to be sealed.
The vicious creature with blood-red eyes was very long, and its two jade-colored wings were crossed and wrapped around its body. Only the bottom of the knees of its legs was exposed, but the exposed parts were scarred and seemed to have many densely packed runes.
This is only the result of a moment.
At this moment, Jiang Chen's whole body froze, and at the same time he felt completely cold. It was as if an extremely piercing chill rushed directly into his body, making him shiver.
With just a moment of induction, Jiang Chen's soul power was interrupted and disappeared.
But this moment left an unfathomable impression on Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen felt that he would never be able to forget this extremely profound scene in his entire life.
"Woo-"
"Yoyo——"
Jiang Chen woke up, but there was always a scream in his ears.
Jiang Chen's hand suddenly loosened, and the ancient jade sword immediately fell to the ground.
All abnormalities disappeared immediately.
Jiang Chen remained silent.
Before, he had some doubts, suspecting that Jiang Feng had entered a forbidden place and obtained this ancient sword.
Now, he was almost certain that it was.
Not only this ancient sword, but also the three sets of 'Wind Spirit Avoiding Dust Armor' are also like this.
"But I don't know where I got it. There must be a huge secret there!"
Jiang Chen thought about it, but did not sense the jade ancient sword for the time being. Instead, he picked up the ancient sword again and put it into the Qiankun Ring.
Later, Jiang Chen took out his azure blue ancient scroll "Tianhe Sword Art" from the Qiankun Ring.
Now, his main focus is to truly comprehend the "Tianhe Sword Art".
"Tianhe Sword Art" has six levels on the surface, but there is additional information in the sword art volume. This kind of information is not presented in the blue ancient scroll, but needs to be read in the way of soul cultivation. That additional information includes additional training methods for "Tianhe Sword Art".
Three years ago, Jiang Chen did not understand the additional training methods of "Tianhe Sword Art", and the copy he gave to Lin Xueyao only had the basic six levels.
This is fortunate.
However, this is also because Jiang Chen's soul power cultivation was not successful at the beginning.
Now, Jiang Chen took out the "Tianhe Sword Jue" because he wanted to truly understand the "Tianhe Sword Jue" as a whole.
Jiang Chen deeply understands that in any practice, the overall situation is very important. Only by grasping the overall situation can the overall practice be more stable.
Another thing is that Jiang Chen has special self-confidence. Now his comprehension is very outstanding. If combined with the blood-colored soul sea space between his eyebrows, it will not be difficult to comprehend any technique.
Jiang Chen watched "Tianhe Sword Art" carefully. Although he knew that the text itself also carried momentum, it was impossible for Jiang Chen to understand this at the beginning.
But now Jiang Chen deeply understands this.
Therefore, this time, he read "Tianhe Sword Art" completely once, and the traces of those words were deeply engraved in his mind.
Later, Jiang Chen used the method of soul cultivation, gathered soul power, and sensed the "Tianhe Sword Art".
"Buzz——"
As soon as the soul power surged and sensed it, the "Tianhe Sword Art" immediately shook and turned into a stream of light, which suddenly shot into Jiang Chen's eyebrows.
"Huh?"
Jiang Chen was slightly surprised. He had never thought that this was the case.
However, Jiang Chen didn't find it strange. In fact, ordinary monks didn't have soul sensing ability. Even if they did, their ability to use it was very superficial.
He has it, many reasons are because of the "Tianhe Sword Art"The method of soul cultivation.
Since "Tianhe Sword Art" is related to the soul, it is not surprising to think that it can enter the soul.
Jiang Chen concentrated and held his breath, and immediately entered the soul space using the method of meditation.
As soon as he entered the bloody soul ocean space, Jiang Chen discovered that all the blood in the space had disappeared.
This is a very beautiful void. Above the void, many colorful divine lights hang like rainbows.
In the rainbow, there are vaguely endless and silent colorful divine thunders.
And below the void is a silent ocean.
The ocean is incredibly clear.
Right now, there is no land in this void, only the blue sea and the colorful void, like a world with clear sky and clear air.
Jiang Chen was quite surprised. He did not expect that the soul space would change like this unexpectedly.
However, after feeling such a sense of surprise, Jiang Chen immediately understood that it was because his soul was now truly clear.
